versions.changelog:
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Updated the SKILL.md with a streamlined description and improved onboarding/authorization instructions.
- Added CLI-based authentication instructions and clarified funding workflows.
- No changes to categorization workflow or underlying functionality.

- Initial release of jev-email skill for classifying inbox previews using WorkerKit from OpenClaw.
- Guides users through account setup, connection authorization, kit installation, deployment, and bounded classification runs.
- Supports Google and Microsoft email accounts; focuses on sender, subject, and preview fields without accessing full message bodies.
- Emphasizes proper setup steps, authorization, and secure handling of credentials.
- Detailed instructions for installation, category customization, funding checks, and running classification with clear, secure workflow guidance.
